## Innovating for the Future

For more than 160 years Armstrong has invested in manufacturing excellence, market-driven
innovation, and strategic acquisitions that broadened our portfolio of products and solutions. This
includes our innovative TEMPLOK Energy Saving Ceilings which help save on energy costs and usage.
Plus, these ceilings may qualify for up to 50% in Investment Tax Credits.

[ Explore Energy Saving Ceilings ][68] [ Learn About Tax Credits ][69]

## From Vision to Reality

Every project is unique with specific requirements. From small, standard product layouts to large,
custom ceiling concepts, PROJECTWORKS supports it all.
* [ Design Support for Standard Solutions ][70]
  
  As a project journeys from schematic design through material installation, there are three unique
  services PROJECTWORKS provides to support the customer through the various construction phases:
  Design Consultation, Design Service, and Pre-Construction Service.
* [ Design Support for Custom Solutions ][71]
  
  We deliver a streamlined set of deliverables that help keep custom projects on target and within
  budget. Start to finish, we can help oversee the execution of the design, reducing unnecessary
  challenges.

[ Explore PROJECTWORKS ][72]

Sustainability

## Building a Better Today for Tomorrow

Sustainability has been part of Armstrong since our founding. A century and a half later, we are
still leading a transformation in the design and building of spaces that prioritize the health of
our planet.

Our sustainability commitment has three pillars: Healthy and Circular Products, Healthy Planet, and
Thriving People and Communities.

[ Explore Sustainability ][73]

## Our Commitment to Community Service

Since 1985, the Armstrong World Industries (AWI) Foundation has been actively supporting the
communities where we operate. The AWI Foundation provides funding for organizations and sustainable
buildings that improve the quality of life in our communities. Through these efforts, AWI Foundation
has made a significant impact on the lives of people in Lancaster, Pa., where our company is
headquartered, and across the country.

## Innovating for the Future

For more than 160 years Armstrong has invested in manufacturing excellence, market-driven
innovation, and strategic acquisitions that broadened our portfolio of products and solutions. This
includes our innovative TEMPLOK Energy Saving Ceilings which help save on energy costs and usage.
Plus, these ceilings may qualify for up to 50% in Investment Tax Credits.

[ Explore Energy Saving Ceilings ][68] [ Learn About Tax Credits ][69]

## From Vision to Reality

Every project is unique with specific requirements. From small, standard product layouts to large,
custom ceiling concepts, PROJECTWORKS supports it all.
* [ Design Support for Standard Solutions ][70]
  
  As a project journeys from schematic design through material installation, there are three unique
  services PROJECTWORKS provides to support the customer through the various construction phases:
  Design Consultation, Design Service, and Pre-Construction Service.
* [ Design Support for Custom Solutions ][71]
  
  We deliver a streamlined set of deliverables that help keep custom projects on target and within
  budget. Start to finish, we can help oversee the execution of the design, reducing unnecessary
  challenges.

Sustainability has been part of Armstrong since our founding. A century and a half later, we are
still leading a transformation in the design and building of spaces that prioritize the health of
our planet.

### Boral introduces Australia’s first crumbed rubber asphalt from recycled industrial tyres

## News

[
[Boral and SRG staff at Perth's Women and Babies Hospital during concrete pour]

### Perth teams pour it on for landmark hospital

Boral supplied 2,200m³ of Envirocrete for a major continuous concrete pour at Perth's new Women and
Babies Hospital, supporting this landmark healthcare infrastructure project in Western Australia.

arrow_forward
][102]
[
[Concrete footpath being finished with a broom]

### Order concrete online with the Boral Concrete App

Order concrete online in minutes with the Boral Concrete App. Get quotes, schedule delivery, pay
securely and track your order all in one place.

arrow_forward
][103]
[
[Old explosives storage building located near the quarry pit at Coldstream Quarry]

### A piece of history at Coldstream Quarry

Explore a 100-year-old explosives magazine at Boral’s Coldstream Quarry in Victoria and discover how
early quarrying practices were designed with safety in mind.

arrow_forward
][104]
[
[Boral employee Frank Lourey in PPE standing at quarry site]

### Boral's Frank Lourey selected as Institute of Quarrying Australia Ambassador

Boral Production Manager Frank Lourey has been selected as an Institute of Quarrying Australia
Ambassador for 2026, recognising his commitment to mentoring and industry leadership.

arrow_forward
][105]
[
[Tradie standing with Boral new plastic packaging]

### Boral transitions bagged dry mix products to recycled plastic packaging

Boral introduces innovative plastic packaging for cement products, improving durability, handling
and sustainability across construction projects in Australia.

arrow_forward
][106]
[
[Birds-eye view of powered lime on grey background]

### How Lime is Made from Limestone

Learn how limestone is transformed into quicklime and hydrated lime through the lime manufacturing
process. Discover how lime products are used across construction, water treatment, mining and
agriculture.

arrow_forward
][107]
[
[Wendy Purvis – Wellcamp Loader Driver & Plant Operator]

### From healthcare to quarrying: Wendy Purvis builds a new path at Wellcamp

Discover how Wendy Purvis transitioned from healthcare to a plant operator role at Boral’s Wellcamp
Quarry, building new skills and a career in quarrying.

arrow_forward
][108]
[
[Jordan from Boral with Peats Ridge Public School's new Defibrillator]

### Giving back at Peats Ridge

Boral’s Peats Ridge Quarry has donated a life-saving defibrillator to Peats Ridge Public School,
supporting community safety in a rural NSW region.

arrow_forward
][109]
[
[Tania O'Neill with colleague on site in PPE]

### Tania Neill on building lasting customer partnerships in Victoria

Learn how Boral’s Victorian Concrete Business Development Manager, Tania Neill, builds strong
customer partnerships to support major construction projects.

arrow_forward
][110]
[
[Photo of Henry Miller in PPE]

### Creating opportunities on Country: Henry’s story at Dundowran Quarry

Learn how Boral’s partnership with the Butchulla Native Title Aboriginal Corporation is creating
employment pathways on Country, including Henry’s journey at Dundowran Quarry.

Holcim (SIX: HOLN) is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15.7
billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to
buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 45 000 employees in 43 attractive
markets – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East & Africa – and has been recognized as a
Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high-value end-to-end Building
Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by
premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet and ECOCycle.

# Siniat Universal Board™

A minimum of 27% post consumer recycled gypsum content

[Learn more][41]
What are you looking for?

## Discover more

Siniat is one of the leading manufacturers of interior and exterior materials for drywall
construction, and forms part of the 60-brand strong, industrial group Etex. This collaboration of
proven brands provides us with a resource of exceptional experience and knowledge in the field of
construction. This enables us to provide high level support for the most demanding projects and
recognise potential efficiencies with the introduction of new products and construction methods.

### PRODUCTS & SYSTEMS

We develop products and systems that help make your building warmer, dryer, quieter and safer to
work and live in. Our extensive range of boards and metal frame systems combine to create tailored,
high performance cost effective solutions for any type of building construction.

[PRODUCTS & SYSTEMS]

### REFERENCE CASES

From conception to completion, find out how we help architects, engineers and installers meet the
demands of the most challenging and wide ranging building projects.

[REFERENCE CASES]

### DOCUMENTATION

Our Documentation Library will provide you with all the supporting certificates, technical and
safety datasheets, How-To Guides and other sources of useful information to support you throughout
the complete specification, design and build process.

[DOCUMENTATION]

## About Siniat

[Simple banner image]

# The dry construction materials specialist

Siniat is a leading manufacturer of interior and exterior dry construction materials. As part of
Etex, a large industrial group with a portfolio of over 60 brands across the world, we have
extensive knowledge of the construction industry. It’s this knowledge that enables us to support our
partners and customers and continue to invest in innovation and the way people build and live.

[ Discover Siniat ][42]

### Tested & Certified Solutions

### Committed to Sustainable Construction

# THE POWER, THE PROMISE, THE PARTNERSHIP OF AD.

AD is a member owned group. We are passionate about bringing growth-oriented independent
distributors and best-in-class suppliers together to outperform the market and to stay ahead of the
competition.

[JOIN AD][76]   

[ [2019-2024 top workplace award presented by the philadelphia inquirer. USA Today Top Workplace
2024. Best Workplaces Canada - Great Place to Work.] ][77]
Over
1,000
Independent Distributor Members
Over
9,000
Locations
Over
150,000
Employees
More than
$100B
in annual sales

### Financial Benefits

## A BETTER BOTTOM LINE.

Leverage our size and scale to drive your growth and reduce costs. Build relationships with the best
to gain market share and outpace the industry. We averaged 100% supplier rebate distributions over
the last ten years. We have successfully outpaced the US GDP nearly every year since our founding.

[Distributor Benefits][78] | [Supplier Benefits][79]

MARKET
AD

### Relationships

## Together, We Win.

Investing in relationships is the key to our over 40 years of success. The relationships we actively
facilitate between our members and supplier partners, and those we build with them, help us
understand each other’s unique needs so together we can grow our businesses. Individual attention
and personalized support is what we do different and better than anyone else.

[Distributor Benefits][80] | [Supplier Benefits][81]

### Entrepreneurial Spirit

## THE SPIRIT THAT DRIVES US ALL.

We are living in a changing world and we are never satisfied with the status quo. Our innovative
mindset enables us to take risks, while our size affords us the resources to make investments in
programs to help our members compete today and tomorrow.

[Distributor Benefits][82] | [Supplier Benefits][83]
* Member Owned & Transparent to
  the Local Level
  
  Our industry-specific Boards led by our owner/members govern every financial, programmatic, and
  strategic aspect of our organization, because we respect that our independent distributors and
  supplier partners know what is best for their companies. It is our associates’ commitment to
  provide personal attention to help them achieve their goals.
  
  [Learn More][84]
* Our Passion, Purpose, and Pride
  
  We put our all into leveraging our unique economies of scale, robust financial systems and
  people-first approach to help independent distributor members outperform the competition,
  best-in-class suppliers protect their brands and diversify their channel strategy, and associates
  perform at their best.
  
  [LEARN MORE][85]
* Serving Others
  
  Giving back is a joyful responsibility and a value we share with our distributors and supplier
  partners, who realize that some of our world’s biggest problems can be solved within our
  communities by regular people working to make a difference in the lives of others.
  
  [Learn More][86]

## Measure once, estimate the full drywall package, then buy with confidence

The fastest way to use a drywall calculator is to think like an estimator, not just like a shopper.
Start with the room envelope, decide whether the ceiling is part of the scope, and then translate
that surface area into sheets, finishing materials, and jobsite handling needs. This page is built
so you can move from rough takeoff to material planning without opening a second tool.

[Illustration showing how to use a drywall calculator by measuring walls, choosing sheet size, and
reviewing summary totals] A simple three-step workflow: measure the room, choose board settings, and
review the summary before ordering.
1

### Enter dimensions

Add room length, width, and ceiling height. If you are boarding the ceiling, turn that option on so
ceiling area is included in your drywall sheet calculator result.

2

### Choose the board strategy

Pick 4x8, 4x9, 4x10, or 4x12 drywall and set a waste factor based on layout complexity. Larger
boards reduce seams, but they are harder to move and hang.

3

### Use the linked calculators

The other tabs reuse your sheet count so you can estimate drywall cost, joint compound, screws, and
total weight. Print or copy the summary for the supply yard.

When people search for a drywall calculator, they usually want one answer: how much drywall should I
buy? In practice, a useful estimate needs more context. The cheapest mistake in drywall is often
ordering an extra sheet. The expensive mistakes are underestimating labor, running out of mud
halfway through finishing, or loading so much board into a pickup that the trip becomes unsafe. That
is why this tool keeps sheets, cost, mud, screws, and weight together on one page. Use the summary
as a planning estimate, then confirm framing layout, specialty board requirements, and local pricing
before placing the final order.

How many sheets of drywall do I need

## 12x12 room: how many sheets of drywall do I need?

A standard drywall sheet calculator starts with total surface area. For walls, multiply the room
perimeter by ceiling height. If the ceiling is being finished too, multiply room length by room
width and add that number to the wall area. From there, subtract openings such as doors and windows.
Finally, divide the adjusted area by the square footage covered by one sheet and add a waste factor.

Total sheets = ((wall area + ceiling area - openings) x (1 + waste factor)) / sheet area

For a 12x12 room with 8 foot ceilings, the wall perimeter is 48 feet. Multiply that by 8 feet and
you get 384 square feet of wall area. If you also include the ceiling, that adds another 144 square
feet for a total of 528 square feet. Subtract one door and one window and the working area drops to
492 square feet. Divide by 32 square feet for a 4x8 sheet and you land just over 15 sheets. Add 10
percent waste and you are in the 17 sheet range, which is why many people searching for "12x12 room
how many sheets of drywall" end up buying 17 or 18 sheets depending on openings and cut layout.

Waste matters because drywall is not installed as perfect rectangles on a spreadsheet. You will cut
around receptacles, doors, windows, soffits, plumbing penetrations, and ceiling fixtures. Edge
damage during delivery and handling also eats into usable material. For clean rectangular rooms, 10
percent waste is a reasonable default. If the room has many corners, a sloped ceiling, or several
built-ins, pushing the waste factor closer to 15 percent is safer.

Board orientation changes yield as well. Hanging drywall horizontally on walls can reduce seam
count, especially in rooms with 8 or 9 foot ceilings, but it can also create longer offcuts. In
basements and garages, larger sheets sometimes lower both seam count and waste. In bathrooms and
tight remodels, smaller boards can be easier to maneuver, which reduces breakage and bad cuts even
if seam count goes up a little.

Drywall sheet calculator inputs

## Drywall sheet calculator and sheet sizes guide

Sheet size directly affects seam count, labor speed, waste, handling difficulty, and the number of
screws you need. The best board is not always the largest one.

4 x 8 32 sq ft DIY and smaller rooms 4 x 9 36 sq ft 9 ft ceilings and stairwells 4 x 10 40 sq ft
Long walls and medium ceilings 4 x 12 48 sq ft Open rooms and large ceilings

──────────┬────────┬───────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────
Sheet size│Coverage│Best use                       │Main tradeoff                   
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 8     │32 sq ft│Small rooms, remodels, DIY work│More seams on long walls        
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 9     │36 sq ft│9 ft ceilings and stairwells   │Less common stock item          
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 10    │40 sq ft│Long walls, medium ceilings    │Heavier to move and lift        
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 12    │48 sq ft│Open rooms and large ceilings  │High weight and awkward handling
──────────┴────────┴───────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────

If you are working alone or carrying sheets through finished spaces, 4x8 drywall is often the smart
choice even when longer sheets look cheaper on paper. Fewer broken corners and less wrestling with
material can erase the theoretical seam savings of a 12 foot board. On the other hand, crews hanging
drywall in open-plan rooms often prefer 4x10 or 4x12 sheets because labor savings can outweigh the
added board cost.

Use the sheet size selector in this drywall sheet calculator to compare coverage and to see how that
choice cascades into screw counts and carrying weight. A material plan is only good if it still
makes sense when the truck arrives and the boards have to move from curb to room.

Board selection

## Types of drywall

Not every room needs the same board. Standard drywall is the baseline for most interior walls and
ceilings, but moisture, fire separation, and sound control can change the spec. Choosing the right
board type early helps you budget accurately because specialty panels usually cost more and often
weigh more too.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────
Type             │Where it fits                          │Why people choose it                      
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Standard 1/2"    │Bedrooms, living rooms, halls          │Lowest cost and easy availability         
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Moisture-resistan│Bathrooms, laundry rooms, utility areas│Better humidity tolerance than standard   
t                │                                       │board                                     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Fire-rated Type X│Garages, shared walls, code-required   │Added fire resistance and stiffness       
                 │assemblies                             │                                          
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Soundproof       │Media rooms, duplex walls, offices     │Improved acoustic performance with layered
assemblies       │                                       │systems                                   
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────

Moisture-resistant drywall is not a substitute for proper tile backer in direct wet areas, but it is
a practical upgrade in bathrooms and laundry spaces where humidity is higher than normal. Fire-rated
drywall is heavier and less forgiving to cut, yet it is essential when the wall assembly needs to
meet code. Soundproofing often depends on the whole assembly, including insulation, resilient
channel, sealant, and sometimes double layers, so board type alone rarely tells the full story.

## Measure once, estimate the full drywall package, then buy with confidence

The fastest way to use a drywall calculator is to think like an estimator, not just like a shopper.
Start with the room envelope, decide whether the ceiling is part of the scope, and then translate
that surface area into sheets, finishing materials, and jobsite handling needs. This page is built
so you can move from rough takeoff to material planning without opening a second tool.

[Illustration showing how to use a drywall calculator by measuring walls, choosing sheet size, and
reviewing summary totals] A simple three-step workflow: measure the room, choose board settings, and
review the summary before ordering.
1

### Enter dimensions

Add room length, width, and ceiling height. If you are boarding the ceiling, turn that option on so
ceiling area is included in your drywall sheet calculator result.

2

### Choose the board strategy

Pick 4x8, 4x9, 4x10, or 4x12 drywall and set a waste factor based on layout complexity. Larger
boards reduce seams, but they are harder to move and hang.

3

### Use the linked calculators

The other tabs reuse your sheet count so you can estimate drywall cost, joint compound, screws, and
total weight. Print or copy the summary for the supply yard.

When people search for a drywall calculator, they usually want one answer: how much drywall should I
buy? In practice, a useful estimate needs more context. The cheapest mistake in drywall is often
ordering an extra sheet. The expensive mistakes are underestimating labor, running out of mud
halfway through finishing, or loading so much board into a pickup that the trip becomes unsafe. That
is why this tool keeps sheets, cost, mud, screws, and weight together on one page. Use the summary
as a planning estimate, then confirm framing layout, specialty board requirements, and local pricing
before placing the final order.

How many sheets of drywall do I need

## 12x12 room: how many sheets of drywall do I need?

A standard drywall sheet calculator starts with total surface area. For walls, multiply the room
perimeter by ceiling height. If the ceiling is being finished too, multiply room length by room
width and add that number to the wall area. From there, subtract openings such as doors and windows.
Finally, divide the adjusted area by the square footage covered by one sheet and add a waste factor.

Total sheets = ((wall area + ceiling area - openings) x (1 + waste factor)) / sheet area

For a 12x12 room with 8 foot ceilings, the wall perimeter is 48 feet. Multiply that by 8 feet and
you get 384 square feet of wall area. If you also include the ceiling, that adds another 144 square
feet for a total of 528 square feet. Subtract one door and one window and the working area drops to
492 square feet. Divide by 32 square feet for a 4x8 sheet and you land just over 15 sheets. Add 10
percent waste and you are in the 17 sheet range, which is why many people searching for "12x12 room
how many sheets of drywall" end up buying 17 or 18 sheets depending on openings and cut layout.

Waste matters because drywall is not installed as perfect rectangles on a spreadsheet. You will cut
around receptacles, doors, windows, soffits, plumbing penetrations, and ceiling fixtures. Edge
damage during delivery and handling also eats into usable material. For clean rectangular rooms, 10
percent waste is a reasonable default. If the room has many corners, a sloped ceiling, or several
built-ins, pushing the waste factor closer to 15 percent is safer.

Board orientation changes yield as well. Hanging drywall horizontally on walls can reduce seam
count, especially in rooms with 8 or 9 foot ceilings, but it can also create longer offcuts. In
basements and garages, larger sheets sometimes lower both seam count and waste. In bathrooms and
tight remodels, smaller boards can be easier to maneuver, which reduces breakage and bad cuts even
if seam count goes up a little.

Drywall sheet calculator inputs

## Drywall sheet calculator and sheet sizes guide

Sheet size directly affects seam count, labor speed, waste, handling difficulty, and the number of
screws you need. The best board is not always the largest one.

4 x 8 32 sq ft DIY and smaller rooms 4 x 9 36 sq ft 9 ft ceilings and stairwells 4 x 10 40 sq ft
Long walls and medium ceilings 4 x 12 48 sq ft Open rooms and large ceilings

──────────┬────────┬───────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────
Sheet size│Coverage│Best use                       │Main tradeoff                   
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 8     │32 sq ft│Small rooms, remodels, DIY work│More seams on long walls        
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 9     │36 sq ft│9 ft ceilings and stairwells   │Less common stock item          
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 10    │40 sq ft│Long walls, medium ceilings    │Heavier to move and lift        
──────────┼────────┼───────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
4 x 12    │48 sq ft│Open rooms and large ceilings  │High weight and awkward handling
──────────┴────────┴───────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────

If you are working alone or carrying sheets through finished spaces, 4x8 drywall is often the smart
choice even when longer sheets look cheaper on paper. Fewer broken corners and less wrestling with
material can erase the theoretical seam savings of a 12 foot board. On the other hand, crews hanging
drywall in open-plan rooms often prefer 4x10 or 4x12 sheets because labor savings can outweigh the
added board cost.

Use the sheet size selector in this drywall sheet calculator to compare coverage and to see how that
choice cascades into screw counts and carrying weight. A material plan is only good if it still
makes sense when the truck arrives and the boards have to move from curb to room.

Board selection

## Types of drywall

Not every room needs the same board. Standard drywall is the baseline for most interior walls and
ceilings, but moisture, fire separation, and sound control can change the spec. Choosing the right
board type early helps you budget accurately because specialty panels usually cost more and often
weigh more too.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────
Type             │Where it fits                          │Why people choose it                      
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Standard 1/2"    │Bedrooms, living rooms, halls          │Lowest cost and easy availability         
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Moisture-resistan│Bathrooms, laundry rooms, utility areas│Better humidity tolerance than standard   
t                │                                       │board                                     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Fire-rated Type X│Garages, shared walls, code-required   │Added fire resistance and stiffness       
                 │assemblies                             │                                          
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────
Soundproof       │Media rooms, duplex walls, offices     │Improved acoustic performance with layered
assemblies       │                                       │systems                                   
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────

Moisture-resistant drywall is not a substitute for proper tile backer in direct wet areas, but it is
a practical upgrade in bathrooms and laundry spaces where humidity is higher than normal. Fire-rated
drywall is heavier and less forgiving to cut, yet it is essential when the wall assembly needs to
meet code. Soundproofing often depends on the whole assembly, including insulation, resilient
channel, sealant, and sometimes double layers, so board type alone rarely tells the full story.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

**You may be wondering, how does drywall work? What to do with drywall?, we can advise you:**

Drywall, also known as gypsum board or hardboard, is a building material composed of a paper
substrate and gypsum (calcium sulfate). It is a very innovative material since it does not use water
due to its dry construction, therefore, it is used in the construction of interior walls and
ceilings. Gypsum panels are a more economical material for the division and construction of ceilings
and walls than traditional brick and cement construction. It is also faster to install, lightweight,
fire resistant, comfortable for temperature, reduces exterior sound, and provides a better
appearance.

Drywall can be used to divide space, build structures or shelving. Vertical or horizontal drywall
installation is used to design interiors (ceilings and walls).

The drywall installation process, although it may seem quick and easy, should only be performed by
drywall specialists such as the local drywall installers at New Corporation Drywall. Which will
ensure its longevity, design, finish and overall presentation. If you are someone who cares about
the quality of the services you hire, with us you won’t have to worry, thanks to our years of
experience we guarantee our work.

/// A quantity you can defend

## From tape measure to supplier list.

ProjectQty keeps the path visible. Change an input and see exactly which order quantity changes.
1. 01
   
   ### Measure the space
   
   Add rectangular or circular areas instead of hiding irregular projects inside one estimate.
2. 02
   
   ### Set assumptions
   
   Choose waste, package size, density, or a local price. Defaults stay visible and editable.
3. 03
   
   ### Verify the order
   
   Review base quantity, adjustment, order-unit rounding, formula, and sources before buying.

/// No mystery numbers

## A calculator should show its work.

Material estimates are sensitive to field measurements, moisture, compaction, mix design, packaging,
and supplier rules. We make those variables explicit instead of dressing one national average up as
certainty.

everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Three steps, from photo to redesign

### Snap your room

just the way it is right now.

2

### Pick a style

Choose from 100+ looks, from Modern and Scandinavian to Industrial, Farmhouse, Coastal and Boho. Tap
and go.

3

### Get your redesign

RoomGPT generates a photorealistic makeover in seconds, built on your real space. Love it, tweak it,
or try another style.

## Why Choose RoomGPT?

Design with confidence, not guesswork

🏠

### It's Actually Your Room

RoomGPT redesigns the space you photographed — keeping your layout, windows and proportions — so the
result feels real and buildable, not a generic showroom shot.

💰

### See It Before You Spend It

Preview a whole new look on your own walls before you commit to paint, furniture or a designer.
Decide with confidence instead of guesswork.

💬

### Refine by Chatting

Want a darker sofa or warmer lighting? Tell RoomGPT in plain words and it reworks the design for you
— no design skills needed.

What is RoomGPT?

RoomGPT is an AI interior-design app that reimagines your actual rooms. Snap a photo of any space
and RoomGPT generates a redesigned version you can picture living in. Download the free app for iOS
or Android and try it on your own room.

Is RoomGPT free?

Yes. RoomGPT is free to download on both the App Store and Google Play, and you can start
redesigning your rooms right away.

How does RoomGPT work?

Three steps: take or upload a photo of your room, pick a style you love, and RoomGPT's AI redesigns
the space in seconds. No measuring, no software to learn, no design experience needed.

Is RoomGPT available on iOS and Android?

Yes. RoomGPT is available on both iPhone and Android — download it from the App Store or Google
Play.

How many design styles does RoomGPT offer?

RoomGPT offers 100+ design styles, from minimalist and modern to coastal, industrial, Scandinavian
and beyond. Try as many looks as you like on the same room.

Do the results actually match my real room?

Yes. RoomGPT works from a photo of your real room, so the redesign keeps your actual layout and
proportions while reimagining the look and feel — a true preview, not a generic stock photo.

## Redesign Your First Room Today

Download RoomGPT free on iOS and Android, then watch your space transform in seconds.

# 스포츠 팬을 위한 실시간 중계의 새로운 기준
# 스피드티비

스피드티비는 전 세계 다양한 스포츠 경기를 고품질 영상으로 실시간 스트리밍 제공하며, 생동감 넘치는
경기 장면을 놓치지 않고 무료로 시청할 수 있는 스포츠 팬을 위한 공간입니다. 국내 팬들에게 인기 있는
해외 축구 중계를 비롯해 NBA, MLB, K리그, KBO, UFC, eSports 등 폭넓은 종목의 경기를 시청할 수 있으며,
경기 일정, 결장 선수 정보, 실시간 경기 결과 등 스포츠를 사랑하는 이들에게 종합적인 정보를
제공합니다.

[No.1 스포츠중계 스피드티비]

## 1. 무료 실시간 스포츠중계 서비스

스피드티비는 전세계 모든 스포츠경기를 딜레이없이 시청할 수 있는 플랫폼으로써 제공하는 스포츠중계
메뉴는 이용자들이 전 세계의 주요 실시간 스포츠경기를 무료로 시청할 수 있는 공간입니다.

여기서는 축구, 농구, 배구, 야구, 테니스, 배드민턴, 그리고 격투기 등 다양한 스포츠 종목의 경기를
제공하며, 실시간 중계와 고화질 방송으로 경기를 관람할 수 있습니다.

매일 업데이트되는 경기 일정과 실시간 경기 결과를 확인할 수 있어 팬들이 경기를 놓치지 않도록
도와줍니다.

특히, 하이라이트와 경기 후 리뷰도 제공하여, 경기 전반적인 흐름을 놓친 팬들도 쉽게 핵심 정보를 파악할
수 있습니다.

모바일 및 PC에서도 최적화되어 있어, 언제 어디서나 편리하게 경기를 시청할 수 있습니다.

스포츠 중계 서비스는 사용자의 인터넷 속도에 따라 자동으로 화질을 조정하여 버퍼링 없이 최적화된
스트리밍 환경을 제공합니다.

또한, 실시간 채팅 기능을 제공해 실제 플랫폼 이용자들과 운영진들이 경기 중 실시간 소통하며 경기의
흥미를 더할 수 있도록 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

[스포츠중계 바로가기][169]

## 2. 스포츠분석 (전문가 경기 분석)

무료스포츠중계 전문 플랫폼 스피드티비에서 제공하는 스포츠 분석 메뉴에서는 실제 스포츠 전문가들이
제공하는 심층 분석과 경기 예측 정보를 제공합니다.

각 경기 전, 후에 제공되는 분석은 단순한 결과 예측을 넘어, 팀의 전략과 선수의 상태, 상대 팀 분석 등
다각적인 시각으로 경기를 분석합니다.

# 스피드티비

스피드티비는 전 세계 다양한 스포츠 경기를 고품질 영상으로 실시간 스트리밍 제공하며, 생동감 넘치는
경기 장면을 놓치지 않고 무료로 시청할 수 있는 스포츠 팬을 위한 공간입니다. 국내 팬들에게 인기 있는
해외 축구 중계를 비롯해 NBA, MLB, K리그, KBO, UFC, eSports 등 폭넓은 종목의 경기를 시청할 수 있으며,
경기 일정, 결장 선수 정보, 실시간 경기 결과 등 스포츠를 사랑하는 이들에게 종합적인 정보를
제공합니다.

[No.1 스포츠중계 스피드티비]

## 1. 무료 실시간 스포츠중계 서비스

스피드티비는 전세계 모든 스포츠경기를 딜레이없이 시청할 수 있는 플랫폼으로써 제공하는 스포츠중계
메뉴는 이용자들이 전 세계의 주요 실시간 스포츠경기를 무료로 시청할 수 있는 공간입니다.

여기서는 축구, 농구, 배구, 야구, 테니스, 배드민턴, 그리고 격투기 등 다양한 스포츠 종목의 경기를
제공하며, 실시간 중계와 고화질 방송으로 경기를 관람할 수 있습니다.

매일 업데이트되는 경기 일정과 실시간 경기 결과를 확인할 수 있어 팬들이 경기를 놓치지 않도록
도와줍니다.

특히, 하이라이트와 경기 후 리뷰도 제공하여, 경기 전반적인 흐름을 놓친 팬들도 쉽게 핵심 정보를 파악할
수 있습니다.

모바일 및 PC에서도 최적화되어 있어, 언제 어디서나 편리하게 경기를 시청할 수 있습니다.

스포츠 중계 서비스는 사용자의 인터넷 속도에 따라 자동으로 화질을 조정하여 버퍼링 없이 최적화된
스트리밍 환경을 제공합니다.

또한, 실시간 채팅 기능을 제공해 실제 플랫폼 이용자들과 운영진들이 경기 중 실시간 소통하며 경기의
흥미를 더할 수 있도록 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

## 2. 스포츠분석 (전문가 경기 분석)

무료스포츠중계 전문 플랫폼 스피드티비에서 제공하는 스포츠 분석 메뉴에서는 실제 스포츠 전문가들이
제공하는 심층 분석과 경기 예측 정보를 제공합니다.

각 경기 전, 후에 제공되는 분석은 단순한 결과 예측을 넘어, 팀의 전략과 선수의 상태, 상대 팀 분석 등
다각적인 시각으로 경기를 분석합니다.

이 메뉴는 특히 베팅이나 경기 예측을 고려하는 팬들에게 매우 유용합니다. 예를 들어, 선수들의 최근
성과, 팀의 공격/수비 스타일, 홈 경기/원정 경기에 따른 전략적 차이를 분석하여 보다 정확한 경기 예측을
가능하게 합니다.

경기 분석은 상세한 통계 데이터와 함께 제공되며, 이를 통해 팬들은 상대 전적, 최근 경기를 통한 팀의
변화, 부상 선수, 전술 변화 등을 실시간으로 파악할 수 있습니다.

또한, 각 분석 후에는 스포츠 전문가 인터뷰와 심층적인 분석 영상이 제공되어, 팬들이 경기와 관련된
전문적인 인사이트를 쉽게 얻을 수 있습니다.

주간/월간 리포트 형식으로 제공되는 경기 분석은 팬들이 매 경기마다 중요한 정보들을 놓치지 않고 준비할
수 있도록 돕습니다.

## 3. 스포츠정보
## (축구배당, 순위, 라인업 및 결장자 리스트 제공)

스포츠정보 메뉴는 실시간 스포츠 데이터를 기반으로 플랫폼 이용자들에게 배당 흐름, 팀 순위, 선수
라인업, 결장자 정보, 리그 순위 등을 제공합니다.

각 경기에 대한 배당과 선수 라인업 정보를 빠르게 업데이트하여, 이용자들이 경기 시작 전 최신 정보를
손쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다.

특히, 배당 흐름과 배당 변동을 실시간으로 제공하여, 스포츠 베팅에 대한 참고자료를 제공합니다. 또한,
선수 결장 및 부상자 정보는 경기를 분석하는 데 중요한 요소로, 팬들이 경기 결과를 예측할 때 큰 도움이
됩니다.

이 메뉴에서는 리그 순위, 국제 대회의 진행 상황과 각 팀의 승점 변화를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있어,
팬들이 리그 경쟁 상황을 추적하는 데 유용합니다.

각 팀의 전략적 변화와 상대 팀 전적도 제공되어, 팬들이 더 나은 이해를 가지고 경기를 관람할 수 있도록
돕습니다. 또한, 각 경기 후 통계 분석과 핵심 데이터를 통해 경기 결과에 대한 구체적인 분석을
제공합니다.

## 4. 라이브스코어
## (전 세계 모든 인기 스포츠 실시간 스코어 제공)

라이브스코어 메뉴는 전 세계에서 진행 중인 모든 인기 스포츠 경기의 실시간 점수와 경기 진행 상황을
제공합니다. 해당 메뉴를 통해 축구, 농구, 야구, 배구, 하키 등 다양한 스포츠의 실시간 스코어와 경기
흐름을 확인할 수 있습니다.

이 메뉴에서는 각 팀의 현재 점수, 경기 시간, 득점 선수, 리바운드 등 다양한 세부 통계도 실시간으로
제공하여 팬들이 경기 상황을 면밀히 추적할 수 있습니다.

또한 리그별로 경기 결과를 분류하여, 팬들이 국내 리그와 국제 대회의 모든 경기를 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록
도와줍니다. 실시간 경기 업데이트가 빠르게 반영되며, 각 경기의 승패 결과와 점수 차이를 비교하여
실시간으로 경기 예측을 도와줍니다.

팬들은 통합된 경기 페이지를 통해 한 번에 여러 경기의 스코어와 통계를 한 눈에 볼 수 있어 더욱
편리하게 스포츠를 즐길 수 있습니다.

## 5. 커뮤니티

커뮤니티 메뉴는 스포츠 팬들이 서로 소통하고 의견을 교환하는 공간입니다. 이곳에서는 경기 토론, 경기
예측, 스포츠 관련 뉴스와 같은 다양한 커뮤니케이션 활동을 할 수 있습니다.

팬들이 자유롭게 경기 결과에 대한 의견을 나누고, 자신이 지지하는 팀이나 선수를 응원하는 메시지를
공유할 수 있습니다.

또한, 소셜 기능을 통해 팬들이 각종 경기 관련 챌린지나 스포츠 퀴즈에 참여하며 재미있는 시간을 보낼 수
있습니다. 커뮤니티에서는 팬들 간의 소셜 네트워크를 통해, 친목 활동뿐만 아니라 스포츠 전문가와의
직접적인 소통도 가능합니다.

이용자들은 운영진이 주최하는 이벤트나 경기 예측 대회에 참여하여 리더보드에서 경쟁할 수 있는 기회를
제공합니다. 또한, 커뮤니티 인기 게시물을 통해 최신 경기 분석과 핫한 이슈를 실시간으로 공유할 수
있어, 이용자들이 다양한 정보와 경험을 함께 나눌 수 있습니다.

# 스포츠 팬을 위한 실시간 중계의 새로운 기준
# 스피드티비

스피드티비는 전 세계 다양한 스포츠 경기를 고품질 영상으로 실시간 스트리밍 제공하며, 생동감 넘치는
경기 장면을 놓치지 않고 무료로 시청할 수 있는 스포츠 팬을 위한 공간입니다. 국내 팬들에게 인기 있는
해외 축구 중계를 비롯해 NBA, MLB, K리그, KBO, UFC, eSports 등 폭넓은 종목의 경기를 시청할 수 있으며,
경기 일정, 결장 선수 정보, 실시간 경기 결과 등 스포츠를 사랑하는 이들에게 종합적인 정보를
제공합니다.

[No.1 스포츠중계 스피드티비]

## 1. 무료 실시간 스포츠중계 서비스

스피드티비는 전세계 모든 스포츠경기를 딜레이없이 시청할 수 있는 플랫폼으로써 제공하는 스포츠중계
메뉴는 이용자들이 전 세계의 주요 실시간 스포츠경기를 무료로 시청할 수 있는 공간입니다.

여기서는 축구, 농구, 배구, 야구, 테니스, 배드민턴, 그리고 격투기 등 다양한 스포츠 종목의 경기를
제공하며, 실시간 중계와 고화질 방송으로 경기를 관람할 수 있습니다.

매일 업데이트되는 경기 일정과 실시간 경기 결과를 확인할 수 있어 팬들이 경기를 놓치지 않도록
도와줍니다.

특히, 하이라이트와 경기 후 리뷰도 제공하여, 경기 전반적인 흐름을 놓친 팬들도 쉽게 핵심 정보를 파악할
수 있습니다.

모바일 및 PC에서도 최적화되어 있어, 언제 어디서나 편리하게 경기를 시청할 수 있습니다.

스포츠 중계 서비스는 사용자의 인터넷 속도에 따라 자동으로 화질을 조정하여 버퍼링 없이 최적화된
스트리밍 환경을 제공합니다.

또한, 실시간 채팅 기능을 제공해 실제 플랫폼 이용자들과 운영진들이 경기 중 실시간 소통하며 경기의
흥미를 더할 수 있도록 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

[스포츠중계 바로가기][169]

## 2. 스포츠분석 (전문가 경기 분석)

무료스포츠중계 전문 플랫폼 스피드티비에서 제공하는 스포츠 분석 메뉴에서는 실제 스포츠 전문가들이
제공하는 심층 분석과 경기 예측 정보를 제공합니다.

각 경기 전, 후에 제공되는 분석은 단순한 결과 예측을 넘어, 팀의 전략과 선수의 상태, 상대 팀 분석 등
다각적인 시각으로 경기를 분석합니다.

# 스포츠 팬을 위한 실시간 중계의 새로운 기준
# 스피드티비

스피드티비는 전 세계 다양한 스포츠 경기를 고품질 영상으로 실시간 스트리밍 제공하며, 생동감 넘치는
경기 장면을 놓치지 않고 무료로 시청할 수 있는 스포츠 팬을 위한 공간입니다. 국내 팬들에게 인기 있는
해외 축구 중계를 비롯해 NBA, MLB, K리그, KBO, UFC, eSports 등 폭넓은 종목의 경기를 시청할 수 있으며,
경기 일정, 결장 선수 정보, 실시간 경기 결과 등 스포츠를 사랑하는 이들에게 종합적인 정보를
제공합니다.

[No.1 스포츠중계 스피드티비]

## 1. 무료 실시간 스포츠중계 서비스

스피드티비는 전세계 모든 스포츠경기를 딜레이없이 시청할 수 있는 플랫폼으로써 제공하는 스포츠중계
메뉴는 이용자들이 전 세계의 주요 실시간 스포츠경기를 무료로 시청할 수 있는 공간입니다.

여기서는 축구, 농구, 배구, 야구, 테니스, 배드민턴, 그리고 격투기 등 다양한 스포츠 종목의 경기를
제공하며, 실시간 중계와 고화질 방송으로 경기를 관람할 수 있습니다.

매일 업데이트되는 경기 일정과 실시간 경기 결과를 확인할 수 있어 팬들이 경기를 놓치지 않도록
도와줍니다.

특히, 하이라이트와 경기 후 리뷰도 제공하여, 경기 전반적인 흐름을 놓친 팬들도 쉽게 핵심 정보를 파악할
수 있습니다.

모바일 및 PC에서도 최적화되어 있어, 언제 어디서나 편리하게 경기를 시청할 수 있습니다.

스포츠 중계 서비스는 사용자의 인터넷 속도에 따라 자동으로 화질을 조정하여 버퍼링 없이 최적화된
스트리밍 환경을 제공합니다.

또한, 실시간 채팅 기능을 제공해 실제 플랫폼 이용자들과 운영진들이 경기 중 실시간 소통하며 경기의
흥미를 더할 수 있도록 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

## 2. 스포츠분석 (전문가 경기 분석)

무료스포츠중계 전문 플랫폼 스피드티비에서 제공하는 스포츠 분석 메뉴에서는 실제 스포츠 전문가들이
제공하는 심층 분석과 경기 예측 정보를 제공합니다.

각 경기 전, 후에 제공되는 분석은 단순한 결과 예측을 넘어, 팀의 전략과 선수의 상태, 상대 팀 분석 등
다각적인 시각으로 경기를 분석합니다.

이 메뉴는 특히 베팅이나 경기 예측을 고려하는 팬들에게 매우 유용합니다. 예를 들어, 선수들의 최근
성과, 팀의 공격/수비 스타일, 홈 경기/원정 경기에 따른 전략적 차이를 분석하여 보다 정확한 경기 예측을
가능하게 합니다.

경기 분석은 상세한 통계 데이터와 함께 제공되며, 이를 통해 팬들은 상대 전적, 최근 경기를 통한 팀의
변화, 부상 선수, 전술 변화 등을 실시간으로 파악할 수 있습니다.

또한, 각 분석 후에는 스포츠 전문가 인터뷰와 심층적인 분석 영상이 제공되어, 팬들이 경기와 관련된
전문적인 인사이트를 쉽게 얻을 수 있습니다.

주간/월간 리포트 형식으로 제공되는 경기 분석은 팬들이 매 경기마다 중요한 정보들을 놓치지 않고 준비할
수 있도록 돕습니다.

## 3. 스포츠정보
## (축구배당, 순위, 라인업 및 결장자 리스트 제공)

스포츠정보 메뉴는 실시간 스포츠 데이터를 기반으로 플랫폼 이용자들에게 배당 흐름, 팀 순위, 선수
라인업, 결장자 정보, 리그 순위 등을 제공합니다.

각 경기에 대한 배당과 선수 라인업 정보를 빠르게 업데이트하여, 이용자들이 경기 시작 전 최신 정보를
손쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다.

특히, 배당 흐름과 배당 변동을 실시간으로 제공하여, 스포츠 베팅에 대한 참고자료를 제공합니다. 또한,
선수 결장 및 부상자 정보는 경기를 분석하는 데 중요한 요소로, 팬들이 경기 결과를 예측할 때 큰 도움이
됩니다.

이 메뉴에서는 리그 순위, 국제 대회의 진행 상황과 각 팀의 승점 변화를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있어,
팬들이 리그 경쟁 상황을 추적하는 데 유용합니다.

각 팀의 전략적 변화와 상대 팀 전적도 제공되어, 팬들이 더 나은 이해를 가지고 경기를 관람할 수 있도록
돕습니다. 또한, 각 경기 후 통계 분석과 핵심 데이터를 통해 경기 결과에 대한 구체적인 분석을
제공합니다.

## 4. 라이브스코어
## (전 세계 모든 인기 스포츠 실시간 스코어 제공)

라이브스코어 메뉴는 전 세계에서 진행 중인 모든 인기 스포츠 경기의 실시간 점수와 경기 진행 상황을
제공합니다. 해당 메뉴를 통해 축구, 농구, 야구, 배구, 하키 등 다양한 스포츠의 실시간 스코어와 경기
흐름을 확인할 수 있습니다.

이 메뉴에서는 각 팀의 현재 점수, 경기 시간, 득점 선수, 리바운드 등 다양한 세부 통계도 실시간으로
제공하여 팬들이 경기 상황을 면밀히 추적할 수 있습니다.

또한 리그별로 경기 결과를 분류하여, 팬들이 국내 리그와 국제 대회의 모든 경기를 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록
도와줍니다. 실시간 경기 업데이트가 빠르게 반영되며, 각 경기의 승패 결과와 점수 차이를 비교하여
실시간으로 경기 예측을 도와줍니다.

팬들은 통합된 경기 페이지를 통해 한 번에 여러 경기의 스코어와 통계를 한 눈에 볼 수 있어 더욱
편리하게 스포츠를 즐길 수 있습니다.

직접적인 소통도 가능합니다.

이용자들은 운영진이 주최하는 이벤트나 경기 예측 대회에 참여하여 리더보드에서 경쟁할 수 있는 기회를

추천합니다.

모든 추천사이트는 보증된 업체로서 개인 정보 보호, 안전한 거래를 보장하며, 투명한 운영과 고객
서비스가 우수한 곳만 소개됩니다.

또한, 딜레이없는 환전보장, 24시간 전문 고객지원 시스템, 그리고 신속하고 공정한 운영기준을 제공하는
사이트들만을 선정하여, 스피드티비 이용자들이 안전하게 건전한 온라인 스포츠베팅 문화를 즐길 수 있도록
돕습니다.

[보증업체 리스트 확인하기][174]
[공지사항 및 이벤트 스포츠중계 - 스피드티비]

## 7. 공지사항
## (채널 공지 및 이벤트 정보)

공지사항 메뉴는 대한민국 최고 스포츠중계 제공 플랫폼 스피드티비에서 제공하는 모든 중요 공지사항과
이벤트 정보를 확인할 수 있는 공간입니다.

이용자들에게 중요한 이벤트, 특별 행사, 새로운 기능 추가, 그리고 포인트 전환과 같은 정보를 실시간으로
제공합니다.

이를 통해 사용자들은 이벤트 참여나 프로모션을 놓치지 않고, 언제나 최신 정보를 손쉽게 확인할 수
있습니다. 팬들이 포인트를 각 보증업체 머니로 전환하는 방법에 대한 안내도 제공하여, 이용자들의 경제적
혜택을 최대한 누릴 수 있도록 돕습니다.

또한, 이 메뉴에서는 업데이트와 유지보수 일정, 새로운 기능 제공 등 중요한 사항들을 투명하게 안내하여
이용자들이 언제든지 업데이트된 정보를 얻을 수 있도록 지원합니다.

### Drywall Finishing

Our drywall finishing services are tailored to eliminate surface flaws, poor prep, and inconsistent
texture application. and deliver clean, uniform results.

We complete all phases of finishing, including taping, mudding, sanding, and skim-coating, to create
seamless joints and consistent surfaces. From standard-level finishes and wall textures in homes to

With careful layering, smoothing, and inspection, we deliver surfaces that hold their appearance
over time and meet the visual standards expected across Tempe properties.

### **Ceiling Repair**

There is a myriad of reasons why your ceiling could be damaged, and the type of damage frequently
determines the kind of drywall ceiling repair work required. 


It may not take much effort for repairing stipple ceiling surfaces that have been damaged by
excessive wear. A simple ceiling crack repair job could fix the damaged drywall. 


If you're restoring water-damage ceiling drywall, though, you may need to take extra procedures
throughout the wet ceiling restoration process. We'll walk you through the steps to make sure you're
aware of what needs to be done. 


Whether you need stucco ceiling repair or the repair of a smooth-finish ceiling, we can restore your
ceiling to its former glory!

### **Popcorn Ceiling Removal**

Popcorn texture, which is a stucco mixture applied to the ceilings to produce a rough, sponge-like
texture that resembles popcorn, was previously a popular way to finish ceiling surfaces and was seen
in homes throughout the United States. 


Unfortunately, this wall texture is no longer as popular as it used to be, and since many of them
were installed before the popcorn ceiling asbestos ban was implemented, they must be treated
carefully. 


If you need a contractor to help you with popcorn ceiling removal, getting rid of popcorn ceiling
texture, or applying drywall over a popcorn ceiling, we can help!

carefully.
